claims.text: The deviation is measured on the gps_trace, which POL-RD-01 makes the governing field: the trace records 4.05 km against a booked optimal of 3.2 km, an excess of 0.85 km and 26.56% of optimal. Both limbs of the establishment test pass (0.85 km is greater than 0.8 km absolute AND 26.56% is greater than 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. The rounded convenience copy on the trip record (actual_distance_km 4.0) would yield exactly 0.80 km and fail the absolute limb, which is exactly why the clause says the trace figure governs and why the rider relies on the trace and not on the rounded copy.

The rider discharges the initial burden under POL-RD-08(a): the trip_record, the gps_trace and the fare_breakdown all carry the same trip identifier TRP-02821, and the trace's first fix at 2026-09-17T08:31:41 matches the recorded trip_started event to the second. The rider has also shown an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace, which is POL-RD-08(b).

The burden has shifted to the driver and he has not carried it. His only answer on file is 'Followed the app', which points to no artifact and invokes no clause. POL-RD-08 provides in terms that assertions from either side which cite no evidence id carry no weight and are discarded, and that a general assertion unsupported by a specific artifact does not discharge the driver's burden. The deviation therefore stands at the measured 0.85 km / 26.56%.

The rider's own profile does not trigger the additional-corroboration condition in POL-RD-08: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0, far below the 4-or-more threshold, and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0. The excess here is 26.56%, i.e. below 30%, so the proviso is squarely in play, and on this record it does not bite and no corroboration beyond the gps_trace is required.

No traffic advisory can exonerate the driver. EV-ADVIS-02821-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and its absence is itself citable: no advisory covers the Blk 412 Pasir Ris Dr 6 corridor in this window, so the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and any suggestion that traffic forced the route carries no weight under POL-RD-13. The rider cites the missing artifact deliberately, not as an excuse but as the record of a gap.

POL-RD-04 cannot apply: the chat_log for this trip is empty. EV-CHAT-02821 carries message_count 0 and no messages, so there is no rider instruction, no waypoint_hint and nothing that could have caused the excess. The rider never asked for this detour and the driver has produced nothing to suggest otherwise.

POL-RD-05 cannot apply: neither endpoint was amended. EV-TRIP-02821 shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so no relocation re-quote exists and the booked optimal of 3.2 km is the only correct baseline against which the excess is measured.

POL-RD-12 cannot apply: the vehicle_type on EV-TRIP-02821 is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null. This is not a pooled itinerary, so there is no matched-itinerary baseline to substitute and the booked optimal of 3.2 km governs as usual.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes, so nothing in POL-RD-07 or POL-RD-10(3) assists the driver. EV-GPS-02821 reports coverage_pct 100.0, 37 fixes, a 10-second sample interval, no gaps and max_gap_sec 0.0; there is no gap above 90 seconds, no jump above 500 m and no sampling interval above 30 seconds, so limbs (a) to (c) are all unmet and the deviation may be established on the trace alone.

The remedy is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, which governs because fare_breakdown.fare_model is METERED (POL-RD-11 does not run). charged_total is 9.28; the recomputed fare on the optimal route is (3.80 + 0.75 x 3.2 + 0.28 x 7.0) x 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee = 8.96; there are no ERP lines, no tolls and no chargeable surcharge, and waiting_time_fee and promo_discount are both 0. The rider's entitlement under the clause is therefore 9.28 - 8.96 = SGD 0.32, rounded up to SGD 0.35 at the mandated SGD 0.05 step.

The rider does not stretch the figure. On the arithmetic honestly computed under POL-RD-02 the refund is SGD 0.32 (SGD 0.35 after the mandated round-up), which is below the SGD 0.50 de minimis the same clause sets, so no money moves on this computation and the rider does not ask the tribunal for a sum the policy does not provide. The rider's submission is confined to the findings: the deviation under POL-RD-01 is established, the driver's uncited denial is discarded under POL-RD-08, and no exculpatory clause is available on this record.

claims.text: Even taking the rider's case at its absolute highest, the refund the policy produces is $0.32. On the governing trace figure the trip ran 4.05 km against a booked optimal of 3.2 km, an excess of 0.85 km and 26.56% — which is the rider's high-water mark on this record, and the only figure POL-RD-01 permits for the threshold test.

Run POL-RD-02 on those figures and the money collapses: recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 3.2 + 0.28 x 7.0) x 1.0 surge multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee = 8.96, against a charged_total of 9.28. The refund is 9.28 - 8.96 = $0.32, which is 3.4% of the amount charged — not the $9.28 the rider's claim names.

A $0.32 refund is below the SGD 0.50 de minimis fixed in POL-RD-02, so the clause does not pay it: it directs NO_ACTION. The de minimis gate exists precisely so that a dispute of this size does not move money, and the rider's claim fails on it however the deviation is characterised.

NO_ACTION is party-relative under POL-GEN-03. This dispute was filed by the rider; payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so NO_ACTION leaves the present state standing — the charge stays collected and the driver keeps the fare. It cannot mean the rider is refunded and it cannot mean the charge is restored, because it was never reversed.

The deviation is not MATERIAL. An excess of 0.85 km and 26.56% sits well under POL-RD-01's separate materiality gate of 50% or 8.0 km absolute, so POL-RD-06 is not engaged at all: there is no FULL_REFUND uplift under limb (b) and no driver-conduct referral under limb (c). The case stays on the POL-RD-02 arithmetic and stops there.

The trace is clean for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 37 fixes at a 10 second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds. It does not meet limbs (a) to (c) of that clause, so the trace is not impaired and the POL-RD-10(3) escalation route is not open. The arithmetic above therefore stands as a final ruling and the disputed amount does not go to a human on hold.

No exculpatory comparison can be run, and no escalation follows from that. The driver's counterparty statement is only 'Followed the app' and the chat log carries zero messages, and the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-02821-01, is MISSING with weight 0.0 — so no exoneration under POL-RD-03 or POL-RD-04 is available and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. But under POL-RD-13 an assertion that cites no advisory id is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) is not triggered and the missing artifact is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it. The impaired artifact is disclosed here: EV-ADVIS-02821-01, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT.

There is nothing further to add on the pass-through side: the fare carries zero ERP, zero tolls and zero airport surcharge, and no gantry line lacks a counterpart in the trace. POL-RD-09 yields the rider no standalone correction, so the $0.32 computed above is the whole of the rider's remedy and it is not paid.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this ruling decides the route-deviation dispute on trip TRP-02821, and both submissions converge on the same arithmetic, which I adopt.

1. THE DEVIATION IS ESTABLISHED (POL-RD-01). The governing distance is the GPS trace, which POL-RD-01 makes the controlling field where it disagrees with the trip record. EV-GPS-02821 records trace_distance_km 4.05 against the booked optimal_distance_km of 3.2 on EV-TRIP-02821 — an excess of 0.85 km, or 26.56% of optimal. Both establishment limbs pass (0.85 km > 0.8 km absolute; 26.56% > 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. I note for the rider: the rounded convenience copy on the trip record (actual_distance_km 4.0) would yield exactly 0.80 km and fail the absolute limb, which is precisely why the trace figure governs and why the rider was right to rely on it.

2. NO EXCULPATION. The chat log EV-CHAT-02821 carries 0 messages, so POL-RD-04 (rider-requested detour) cannot run — there is no instruction and no waypoint_hint. Neither endpoint was amended (pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null; amended_optimal_distance_km is null), so POL-RD-05 cannot run. The vehicle type is RYDE_X with solo_optimal_distance_km null, so POL-RD-12 cannot run. The driver's counterparty statement 'Followed the app' points to no artifact and invokes no clause, so under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight and is discarded. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02821-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so no POL-RD-03 closure comparison can be run; because the driver neither asserted an external traffic cause nor cited an advisory identifier, this is a gap in the bundle rather than the contradiction POL-RD-10(5) addresses, and no escalation follows. The impaired artifact and its issue code are disclosed here as POL-GEN-02(1)/(3) requires.

3. THE REMEDY IS ARITHMETIC AND FALLS AWAY (POL-RD-02). The fare is METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs and POL-RD-11 does not run. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 3.2 km + 0.28 x 7.0 min) x 1.0 surge multiplier, read from the fare breakdown) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 toll + 0 surcharge + 0 waiting fee - 0 promo = SGD 8.96. charged_total = SGD 9.28. Refund = 9.28 - 8.96 = SGD 0.32, which would round up to SGD 0.35 at the mandated SGD 0.05 step but is in any event below the SGD 0.50 de minimis the same clause sets. POL-RD-02 therefore directs NO_ACTION, and the rider advocate does not press for any sum the clause does not provide.

4. PASS-THROUGHS (POL-RD-09). The fare carries zero ERP, zero tolls and zero airport surcharge, and no gantry line lacks a counterpart in the trace. Nothing is refundable on this limb.

5. DRIVER COMPENSATION (POL-RD-04). The fare billed 4.0 km against the trace's 4.05 km — a shortfall of 0.05 km, below the 1.0 km threshold — so no compensation arises.

6. DRIVER'S RECORD (POL-RD-06). The deviation is not MATERIAL (26.56% and 0.85 km are both under the 50% / 8.0 km gates), and driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established. There is no FULL_REFUND uplift under limb (b) and no driver-conduct referral under limb (c).
